# immich_plugins (Data Source)

Fetches the list of plugins.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "immich_plugins" "plugins" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `plugins` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plugins))

<a id="nestedatt--plugins"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plugins`

Read-Only:

- `author` (String) The plugin's author.
- `created_at` (String) The time when the plugin was created.
- `description` (String) The plugin's description.
- `id` (String) Plugin Id.
- `methods` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plugins--methods))
- `name` (String) The name of the plugin.
- `title` (String) The title of the plugin.
- `updated_at` (String) The time when the plugin was last updated.
- `version` (String) The plugin's version.

<a id="nestedatt--plugins--methods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plugins.methods`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Method description.
- `host_functions` (Boolean) Has host functions.
- `key` (String) Method key.
- `name` (String) Method name.
- `title` (String) Method title.
- `types` (List of String) The plugin's types.
- `ui_hints` (List of String) The plugin's user interface hints.
